concerns.text: FR-010 requires reproducing the DE and logistic‑regression pipelines on an *independent* solid‑tissue cohort (e.g., METSIM muscle RNA‑seq dataset). However, METSIM is already designated as the primary cohort in FR‑001/FR‑026. Using the same dataset for ‘external’ validation violates the independence of the validation target from the predictors and makes the replication claim circular; the validation is not truly independent.

FR‑005 states that the logistic‑regression model uses “the most variable core circadian genes (pre‑selected by coefficient of variation)”. This variable‑selection step is performed on the full dataset before cross‑validation (FR‑006). Selecting predictors on the entire data set and then evaluating performance on CV folds introduces data leakage, inflating performance metrics and compromising the validity of the reported AUC and odds‑ratio estimates.
